notes.title: About Steam Deck Compatibility Notes
notes.content: [p]The game is compatible with Steam Deck, but the compatibility isn't perfect. If you want a better gaming experience on the Steam Deck, you'll need to make these adjustments:[/p][olist][*][p align="start"]Controller Control: You can search for community layouts. If you can't find a suitable layout in the community, choose the official keyboard (WASD) and mouse layout for perfect game operation compatibility.[/p][/*][*][p align="start"]Resolution: The game may have some UI issues at 1280X800 resolution. When starting the game title, have the character walk off the right edge of the screen to enter the first world (world1). At this point, use the touch screen to click the gear button (settings) in the upper right corner and adjust the resolution to 1280X720 for a more perfect game experience.[/p][/*][/olist][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38800614/71adf98f2de8d042ccdb72391120931e5e4c5d8f.jpg"][/img][/p][p] 3. By default, the game will automatically select a compatibility layer. If this fails, manually selecting Proton 9.0-4 will allow the game to launch.[/p]

notes.title: Jump Kingdom 2024 Edition Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone, after 4 years, "Jump Kingdom" has received an update. Although the game content has not increased, I think this update is very important for the game, so I have written it as a major update.

[h1] Cloud archiving support [/h1]
Traditionally, games have not provided cloud save functionality, but now this feature is supported

Ah。 Is this a major update?
Of course, the above updates cannot be major updates

[h1] New skill: Super floating [/h1]
From now on, you can use the special ability 'Super floating'
The "Super floating" skill can be used in the game by using keyboard E (or I) and controller B (which needs to be adapted in STEAM)

As described, when using skills, the character's "Jump Jump" will remain invincible for a period of time and the gravity will decrease
The advanced operational technique for this ability is to use the skill at the moment of jumping, allowing the character to jump to higher heights

[img] https://shared.fastly.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/818420/extras/%E5%9B%A7%E4%B9%8B%E5%9B%BD_-_2024-11-21_10-26-24.gif?t=1732156341[/img]

By using such skills, the difficulty of the levels can be significantly reduced, and you no longer need to strictly follow the designer's ideas in the game. In addition, in the diamond challenge mode, you can also easily obtain golden diamonds

At the same time, some stages have made slight adjustments to the abilities of this competition. Please find out for yourself

In short, based on the developer's own testing, the addition of this system has brought about significant changes to the gameplay, especially in the Diamond Challenge mode. Developers themselves will also try multiple times in a level to see if they can reach a more extreme time.

Alright, that's all for this update. Have a great game!

notes.title: Today's discount and February discount notice
notes.content:
In our last price guarantee statement, we stated that we would not have any more promotions during 2020, and now that it's 2021, we will start a new round of promotions.
Today (2021-1-5), we will open a promotion at the same price as the first release, and if you miss today, we have another Chinese New Year promotion in February (expected to take place during February 8) at the same price as today.
Have fun with the game!

notes.title: Jump Kingdom is going online soon, price insured statement
notes.content:
We don’t use localized English, and the announcement content uses translation software. If you don’t understand part of the content, please understand

Hello everyone, we are Terobi, an independent game studio from China.   Thank you for like our indie game "Jump Kingdom".
This is an easy horizontal board game,It is our first time to publish a game on the steam platform.
The members of our development team are all steam players and have bought many games on the platform,  so we also understand a truth, that is, "will there be a lower discount just after buying the game", as a user, I met I have been to this kind of shopping experience many times, and I think this kind of experience is very bad.
So we use this announcement to make a statement:

1. At the beginning of the game launch, we will do a promotional activity. After this event, we will not do any further promotional activities in 2020
2. We promise that at least before October 10, 2021, the price of any promotional activities we launch will not be lower than the initial promotional price

We are a humble team,  we are a team that pays great attention to word-of-mouth, so please rest assured.
